notes.title: New Engine & Graphics Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]New Engine & Graphics overhaul! ,[/h1][p]Our biggest update yet is here:[/p][p][b]the New Engine & Graphics Overhaul! 🥳[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b]We did a complete overhaul from scratch of Color-A-Cube because we want to give our players the best experience possible! This means that we've developed a completely new voxel engine in unity and upgraded our entire workflow of how we make and implement our voxel models into the game. 
Not only will you see a massive improvement to the graphics and performance, you'll also see the quality of the game improving.[/p][p]We're reducing the memory footprint , build size and optimizing performance even at a higher render scale and with better anti-aliasing[/p][p]Get ready for new player feedback, fancy effects and even animations!
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]Dark Fantasy pack[/h1][p]We've also just release a new content pack to celebrate our latest collab with Slay the Spire and this update:

notes.title: 🛠️ Important Update: Changes Based on Your Feedback
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Today we want to share some updates that are being implemented effective immediately, based on the feedback we've received over the past few weeks. Your input is incredibly valuable, and we’ve been listening closely.

[b]💬 The Issues You Raised 
[/b]
We've heard your concerns around:[list]
[*] Pricing of DLCs
[*] Lack of free content
[*] Use of Microtransactions (VOX)
[/list]

[h2]✅ What We've Done So Far 
[/h2]Here’s what’s already changed:[list]
[*] We’ve added 14 free models, on top of the original 4, bringing the total to 18 free starter models.
[*] We’ve shared our content roadmap for the next two months.
[*] One of the new paid packs has launched.
[*] The free Viking Pack event!
[/list]

[h2]🆕 What's Changing Today [/h2]
🧩 DLC Pricing & Content [list]
[*] All DLCs will now be priced at €1.99.
[*] Every DLC will contain 10 voxel models, providing more value for your money.
[*] This standardized format will apply to all future DLCs.
[/list]
We're also committed to upgrading all existing DLCs to meet this new standard. Our team is working diligently to ensure that every previously released DLC pack is updated to include a total of 10 models. These upgrades to existing packs will gradually be rolled out, we'll keep you informed on our progress.​

With these changes, we aim to offer a more consistent and valuable experience for those looking to expand their collection.

[b]What happens to existing owners of DLC?
[/b]
These upgrades will be free to anyone who already has these packs.

[h2]💰 VOX Currency Changes 
[/h2][list]
[*] You can no longer buy VOX through the store.
[*] VOX is now earned by completing models. We will introduce new ways to earn VOX in the future (hoping to share more on this soon)
[*] VOX-only packs are temporarily being removed. If you've already purchased one, you keep it.
[/list]
The new role of VOX is simple: it will be used to unlock individual models from the in-game shop that aren't part of any DLC pack.

This opens up multiple paths to getting new models, whether through free content, packs, or the VOX shop.

[b]What happens to existing VOX holders?
[/b]
With VOX now earnable only through gameplay, your existing balance gives you a headstart to the exclusive models in the shop. As we roll out new content in the shop, your VOX will be a valuable asset.​

[h2]🎨 Early Access Game Content Overview 
[/h2]Here’s how you’ll be able to get content moving forward:
[list]
[*] Regularly adding free models to the game through events/collabs
[*] Individual models available in the in-game Shop (using VOX)
[*] Optional DLC packs with 10 models for €1.99
[/list]

[h2]🧊UI Overhaul Update [/h2]

We're thrilled to roll out a major UI update in Color a Cube designed to streamline navigation and improve your overall experience:[list]
[*] New Collection Screen: Players are now brought directly to the Collection screen when starting the game. This new hub displays all your acquired models in a clean, easy-to-navigate layout, giving you quick access to your growing library.
[*] Revamped Shop Interface: The in-game shop has been completely redesigned for improved clarity and usability. 🧾 Items are now organized into clear categories, making it easier to browse and discover new content.
[*] News Tab: Stay in the loop with the new News tab! Here, you'll find the latest updates, announcements, and insights into ongoing development—so you’re always informed about what’s coming next in Color a Cube.
[*] Settings Tab: A dedicated Settings tab has been added, allowing you to easily customize your gameplay experience with access to controls, audio options, and other configurations.
[/list]

[h2]🎉 More Free Events & A Special Collaboration 
[/h2]We're committed to keeping things fresh with regular free events. Following the success previous events, we're excited to announce our first collaboration: Dave the Diver!​

In this special event, you'll have the opportunity to color exclusive voxel models inspired by the underwater adventures of Dave the Diver. Dive into the depths and bring vibrant life to these unique creations.​

Stay tuned for more details on this collaboration and other upcoming free events. We have a lineup of exciting content planned to ensure there's always something new for you to enjoy.​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334772/d063291f5cebddf6f8119cc5fca046e4b05444ec.png[/img]

[h2]💖 Looking Ahead 
[/h2]We're dedicated to expanding Color-A-Cube with both free and paid content, ensuring everyone has a variety of fun, cozy models to color. As a small indie team, we're working hard to increase the amount of content available. Our goal is that, by the time Color-A-Cube reaches its full release, we've delivered a substantial collection of content for all to enjoy.​

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your feedback is invaluable and helps us make the game better for everyone. If you have any more feedback or suggestions, be sure to join our  [url=https://discord.gg/X9Y37VNPEq]Discord[/url]!

-AE Team

notes.title: We've heard your feedback and are taking action!
notes.content:
Hello cube lovers!

Our team has been on the edge of our seats for the past couple of days, eagerly waiting for the Steam release, so we’ve been super excited to hear what you all have to say in our Discord and in the Steam reviews.

We sincerely appreciate all your feedback, both the positive and the constructive. We're taking it to heart and are excited to share some immediate updates and news!

[h2]Bigger Base Game[/h2]
Based on your feedback, we’re [b]tripling [/b]our free base content starting immediately. We’re excited to offer more models for everyone to color, regardless of whether they make any purchases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334772/c9b6fae5f03c41bdbbd36b031909d20419d535cb.png[/img]

[h2]Monthly Content Updates[/h2]
Regular monthly free content updates were already part of our original plan, but we want to clearly emphasize that more content is consistently on the way, both paid and free. Here is a glimpse of what you can expect for the next couple of months!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334772/89091d51504926941e5be5c1f3b6078f404ef9cb.png[/img]

[h2]Let’s Talk[/h2]
We’ve noticed some feedback about our DLC packs and how they fit into the game experience. We’d love to hear your thoughts on how you prefer DLC to be integrated and what type of additional content you'd like to see most.

As we are currently in Early Access, our goal is to continue adding new features and content. We're also actively exploring the best business model to sustainably grow our community. Your feedback plays a crucial role in shaping this process. Please share your thoughts with us, preferably via our [url=https://discord.gg/YWYw5TztXB]Discord channel[/url] or in [b]a comment below[/b], as it helps us tremendously!

We truly appreciate all your feedback, and we remain committed to making the game the best it can be. Stay tuned for more updates, we can’t wait to keep building this game with you!

Best regards
The Color-A-Cube Team
